headline: Casa Mezcal / Barde + vanVoltt
context: Located in the heart of La Condesa, Mexico City, Casa Mezcal is the transformation of a former mezcal tasting facility into a contemporary family residence that celebrates Mexican architecture, craftsmanship, and nature.
